goal: Extract transformation management (transformations list and the two transformation(...) configurators) into a dedicated helper class to reduce the number of public methods and group cohesive behavior.

ops.details: Create a new class net.bytebuddy.build.gradle.android.ByteBuddyAndroidTransformations in the same package. This class encapsulates the List<Transformation> transformations field and the three methods that manage it: getTransformations(), transformation(Closure<Transformation>) and transformation(Action<Transformation>). Provide a constructor ByteBuddyAndroidTransformations(Project project) that initializes its internal list and uses ObjectFactory.newInstance(project, Transformation.class, project) and project.configure(...) as in the original methods.
